description: Weekly crop advice and soil test results for farmers
summary: This page shows weekly crop advisories from the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) and ICAR, and soil health test results for villages in this district from the Soil Health Card portal. Each advisory shows the week it is for, and each soil report shows the date the soil was tested.
